'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Schwartz LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Schmaltz]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Name as written on the Day 2 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
